decisions.reason: The firm has invested heavily in this product and committed to it visibly, with a dedicated page and government references to the UK Home Office and over 30 APIS schemes, so it is central to the firm's aviation security direction.

Demand for travel health requirements is fading after the pandemic, but the dedicated page and its fit with the firm's travel data offer lead management to blame weak results on temporary market conditions.
This module sits close to the firm's established training business and its certified trainers and costs little to keep, though it is committed to only with a passing mention.
Behaviour analysis is core to the firm's specialist detection identity and its announced direction of innovation, so management would persist with it despite low visibility.
Passenger profiling builds on the firm's long-standing aviation security expertise and sunk development effort, which justifies continuing with it.
The dedicated page shows public commitment, and the platform fits closely with the firm's document verification capabilities, so management would hold on to it.
